info.title: Done n Dusted API
info.description:
A productivity system built on DnD ideas.

Resource hierarchy: **Guild (1:N) -> Quest (1:N) -> LogEntry**.
A child resource is reachable only through its parent path; a wrong
chain returns 404. All errors use the same `ApiError`
structure, and all lists are paged `PagedResponse` objects with
self/first/prev/next/last links.

**Authentication (JWT).** `POST /api/auth/login` returns an access token
(valid for 15 min) and a refresh token (7 days). Send the access token
in the `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` header; when it expires, get a new pair
from `POST /api/auth/refresh`. In Swagger UI, use the **Authorize** button.

**Roles.** A guest can only register and log in. In a guild, a user
is a `PLAYER` or the `DUNGEON_MASTER` (the game master, one per guild). `ADMIN` is a global role:
sees all guilds, removes content and manages users.
401: no token or an invalid one; 403: not enough permissions.

patch.summary: Update a log entry and its review result
patch.description:
Partial update: only the fields sent are changed. xpAwarded, inspirationAwarded and
reviewerNote are accepted only together with status. On approval (APPROVED) an omitted xpAwarded
means the XP comes from the quest difficulty. PENDING and REJECTED log entries must
have no XP or inspiration.

the blocked user no longer sees this friendship. To decline, cancel or unblock, use DELETE.

get.description:
Level, XP, stats, inspiration and streak, only from the member's approved (APPROVED) log entries
in this guild. The FULL view (with the 10 latest log entries and the pending count) is for the member,
the guild's game master and ADMIN; other guild members get PUBLIC.

description.description: Free-form guild description; saved as "" when omitted

details.description: Present only when the error concerns specific fields

ownerId.description: User ID of the guild owner (creator)

description.example: A GRIND quest: every approved log entry brings you closer to the goal.

targetCount.description: Required for GRIND quests only; must be omitted for other types

active.description: Whether the quest is still active; true when omitted

xpPerCompletion.description: XP per approved log entry, computed by the server (BASE_XP * multiplier)

LogEntryCreateRequest.description: Data for a new log entry

evidenceUrl.description: Link to evidence, for example a photo

occurredAt.description: When the activity happened; cannot be in the future

authorId.description: Author of the log entry (user ID)

xpAwarded.description: XP frozen at approval; always 0 for PENDING and REJECTED

reviewerId.description: Game master who reviewed the log entry (user ID); absent until reviewed

reviewedAt.description: Absent until the log entry is reviewed

direction.description: OUTGOING if the current user sent the friend request (for BLOCKED, did the blocking); INCOMING if the other user did

respondedAt.description: When the friend request was accepted or blocked; absent while PENDING

RefreshRequest.description: Refresh token from login or from the previous refresh

accessToken.description: JWT; send it in the header Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

refreshToken.description: Single-use token for getting a new pair from /api/auth/refresh

UserUpdateRequest.description: Role or status change made by an admin

enabled.description: false blocks the account (all sessions are revoked)

GuildUpdateRequest.description: Partial guild update: only the fields sent are changed

name.description: New unique name; unchanged when omitted

description.description: New description; unchanged when omitted, "" clears it

QuestUpdateRequest.description: Partial quest update: only the fields sent are changed

description.description: New description; unchanged when omitted, "" clears it
description.example: A GRIND quest: every approved log entry brings you closer to the goal.

type.description: Changing to a non-GRIND type clears targetCount

LogEntryUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of a log entry's content and review result

example.reviewerNote: Approved, even though the photo is blurry.

status.description: New log entry status (the game master's decision)

xpAwarded.description: XP set by the game master; only together with status. When omitted on approval, the quest's XP value is used.

inspirationAwarded.description: Heroic inspiration awarded; only together with status, 0 when omitted

reviewerNote.description: Game master's comment; only together with status
reviewerNote.example: Approved, even though the photo is blurry.

FriendshipUpdateRequest.description: Reply to a friend request, or a block

status.description: ACCEPTED accepts the friend request (recipient only); BLOCKED blocks the other user (either side)

PageLinks.description: prev and next are omitted when there is no such page

totalElements.description: Total number of matching items (across all pages)

CharacterSheetResponse.description: Character sheet: level, XP and stats from approved log entries

guildId.description: Guild; omitted on a friend's character sheet (all guilds combined)

guildName.description: Omitted on a friend's character sheet

role.description: Role in the guild; omitted on a friend's character sheet

view.description: FULL for the user, the guild's game master or ADMIN; PUBLIC for other guild members and friends

totalXp.description: Total XP of all approved log entries

xpIntoLevel.description: totalXp % 100: XP earned in the current level

inspiration.description: Total inspiration of approved log entries

streakDays.description: Consecutive UTC days, ending today or yesterday, with at least one approved log entry (by occurredAt); otherwise 0

stats.description: Always the 6 stats in the order STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA

recentLogs.description: FULL only: the 10 latest approved log entries, newest first

pendingCount.description: FULL only: how many log entries still wait for the game master's review (PENDING)

SheetRecentLog.description: Approved log entry on the character sheet

StatScore.description: Stat score and the XP earned for it
